caption: The drawing features a large, brown ceramic jug with a rounded cylindrical body, a narrow neck, and a single looped handle attaching the neck to the shoulder of the jug. The jug is depicted with light brown and reddish-brown coloring, with subtle shading and spotty marks that give it a textured, somewhat aged appearance. The neck ends in a small, rounded mouth. In the top left corner of the drawing is a smaller, inset illustration showing an enlarged partial view of the jug’s shoulder and neck. In this inset, there is dark blue stamped text reading “J. N. LEMBKE / MANUFACTURER / MOHAWKDALE, LEWIS CO. / NEW YORK” and below it a blue decoration that appears to be a stylized bird or leaf, rendered in simple brushstrokes. The drawing is set on a plain, light background with neat rectangular borders framing both the main image and the inset. The artist’s name, "N. Amantea," and the year "82," are inscribed in the lower left corner of the main frame.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
